company.name: Zus Health
company.shortDescription: Zus Health helps a new wave of healthcare builders to create technologies and services without the usual blockers.
company.description:
Zus Health helps a new wave of healthcare builders create technologies and services without the usual blockers. Zus Health aims to bring forth a better health reality by empowering an inspired new wave of healthcare builders to create digital technologies and services that are cheaper, easier to customize, and far more intimate.

Zus Health was established in 2020 in Watertown, Massachusetts by Jonathan Bush.

productsAndServices.description: A unified, shareable patient profile that consolidates clinical history from multiple sources for use by care teams at the point of care.
productsAndServices.name: Zus Aggregated Profile (ZAP)

productsAndServices.description: A shared health data platform that connects healthcare data sources, creates common patient records, and delivers normalized clinical information for care and software workflows.
productsAndServices.name: Zus Platform (Zus Grid)

productsAndServices.description: API-driven tools and embedded components for retrieving, analyzing, updating, and displaying normalized patient data within healthcare applications and workflows.
productsAndServices.name: Zus API & Components

productsAndServices.description: A standalone browser application that gives care teams access to consolidated patient history and related clinical data without requiring a deep EHR integration.
productsAndServices.name: Zus App

productsAndServices.description: Direct and embedded integrations that place Zus patient history and profile data inside supported EHR and healthcare software platforms.
productsAndServices.name: EHR & SaaS Integrations

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $40,000,000, or 54.05% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $9,214,433 to $190,000,000, a 20.62x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 42 (-2 over 90 days) and market heat at 65 (-3).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include 1upHealth, Health Gorilla, Particle Health.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
